terms.comment: Lewis & Short: also palumbis, palumbus, palumba.

evidence: Verg. E. 1.59: turtur ab ulmō (Lewis & Short)
terms.comment: Properly “sigh, groan”, said of the mournful cry of animals; of the turtle-dove in Vergil.

phrases.latin: avēs magnae inter columbās gravī gradū ambulābant
phrases.english: big birds were walking with heavy steps among the pigeons
phrases.source: Libellus V, Lisbōna: castellum et ōceanārium

sources: Lewis & Short: gemo

Theodōrus et pater · Ad Larem avītum, Libellī I–VII, as they stood on 7 November 2026, with their glosses. Examples marked “Libellus” quote those texts word for word; classical passages are cited by author.
Quotations marked “Lewis & Short” are given as Lewis & Short cites them, in the house spelling; they have not been checked against a modern edition.
